throughline.zh: 台灣封裝與記憶體產業出現新投資核准和未證實的工程消息，馬來西亞資料中心與半導體設備廠則披露融資、廠房及爬坡進度。
throughline.en: Taiwan's packaging sector reported new approvals alongside unverified memory-plant construction claims, while Malaysian data-center and tool-component facilities disclosed funding and ramp schedules.

title.zh: 資料中心融資、供電與通訊備援
title.en: Data-center financing, power and telecom resilience

summary.zh: 11 月 4 日 PDG 宣布取得約 13 億美元綠色融資擴建柔佛 JH1 園區；此前 Google 在馬來西亞公布新投資計畫，雅加達兩座機房亦陸續揭露工程進度。台電供電規劃與嘉義備援基地台提供不同日期的電力及基礎設施資訊。
summary.en: PDG reported about US$1.3B in Johor financing on November 4, following earlier Malaysian data-center plans and Indonesian site openings. Taiwan's power planning and telecom-backup disclosures provide separately dated grid-infrastructure context.

title.zh: 高階封測投資、記憶體新廠與高速基板
title.en: Advanced packaging, memory plant reports and high-speed substrates

summary.zh: 經濟部 11 月 5 日通過日月光 1,237 億元封測規劃與圓益石英 23.4 億元擴廠；臻鼎和矽格同日公布營收及封測實績。美光桃園新廠暫緩工程的外媒說法仍待查證，與前幾日的光子封裝研發及設備軟體整合分屬不同進度。
summary.en: Taiwan approved ASE's NT$123.7B packaging plan and Yuanyi Quartz's NT$2.34B project; Zhen Ding and Sigurd released new results. Reports of a Micron Taoyuan construction pause remain unverified, while earlier photonics research and tool-software integration are separately dated.

title.zh: 東南亞半導體設備製造、晶片測試與網通試產
title.en: Southeast Asian toolmaking, chip-testing and networking trials

summary.zh: FPT 與合勤控披露越南封測及網通試產，新代更新馬來西亞工廠規劃。馬來西亞投資發展局 11 月 5 日首次公開 Ferrotec 居林第二廠的設備配置與投資數字，廠房落成實際發生於 10 月 28 日。
summary.en: FPT and Zyxel reported trial production in Vietnam, while Syntec updated Malaysia plant plans. On November 5 MIDA published the investment and equipment details of Ferrotec's second Kulim plant, whose opening occurred October 28.

title.zh: 工業設備接單、伺服器營收與精密零組件
title.en: Industrial equipment orders, server revenue and precision components

summary.zh: 研華先前公布工業電腦接單與擴廠，英業達說明伺服器缺料；11 月 5 日鴻海及勤誠新增伺服器相關營收與財報，上銀公布精密傳動元件營收。不同公司的月營收、季度淨利與零件交期均使用各自的統計期間。
summary.en: Advantech earlier reported backlog and Inventec described component shortages. On November 5, Hon Hai and Chenbro added server-related financial results while Hiwin reported motion-component sales; their monthly revenue, quarterly profits and delivery lead times use distinct periods.

title.zh: 台灣能源設備、儲能與跨境製造投資
title.en: Taiwan energy equipment, storage and cross-border manufacturing investment

summary.zh: 先前華新麗華公布能源設備合資，金居及湧德公告東南亞子公司增資。11 月 5 日台塑新智能再提出 130 億元現金增資支應彰濱電芯廠二期，相關資金、設計產能與量產目標仍依其實際狀態列示。
summary.en: Earlier Walsin announced an energy-equipment venture and COTECH and UDE reported Southeast Asian subsidiary funding. On November 5 Formosa Smart Energy outlined a NT$13B equity issue for Changbin battery phase two, with funding and future production targets identified separately.
